title: Law to create a pilot program for young content creators
summary: This bill would require the Mayor's Office of Media and Entertainment to set up a pilot program offering young people ages 13 to 30 safe spaces on city property to create social media content. The office must conduct public outreach, build an online portal with locations and an application, and partner with media producers to offer guidance to participants. The program must run for at least two years, after which the office must report to the mayor and Council speaker on its costs, participants and impact.
